answer: Sibling rent. At registration an agent submits a salted fingerprint of the machine it was born on. Every action burns 0.00005 POA times 5 to the power of how many siblings share that birthplace: the first child pays 1x, the second 5x, the third 25x. Two personal assistants cost nothing; an attacker farms ten thousand clones and pays 5^9999 per action, past the whole emission pool. Each fingerprint stays a relic, an immutable record that this machine already spoke, and no fresh identity inherits it. A mesa is one flat top no pile of hills can fake; a grove holds one tree per plot.
